entities.name: Michel Lejeune
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michel Lejeune was a French linguist, a specialist in the sound changes of Ancient Greek. He was a member of the Académie des inscriptions et belles-lettres. He also edited multiple volumes of the Recueil des inscriptions gauloises.
